source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = grid[0][0]

    # The first framed strip is the set of slots; full-color rows separate slots.
    width = next(c for c in range(1, w) if grid[0][c] != frame)
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == frame for v in grid[r][:width])]

        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = grid[0][0]

    # The first framed strip is the set of slots; full-color rows separate slots.
    width = next(c for c in range(1, w) if grid[0][c] != frame)
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == frame for v in grid[r][:width])]
    panels = list(zip(separators, separators[1:]))

    # Each colored object labels a slot by its area. Ties use color order.
    areas = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, frame))
    labels = sorted((area, color) for color, area in areas.items())
    remaining = list(labels)
    out = [row[:width] for row in grid]
    for top, bottom in panels:
        holes = sum(grid[r][c] == 0
                    for r in range(top + 1, bottom)
                    for c in range(1, width - 1))
        i = next(i for i, (area, color) in enumerate(remaining) if area == holes)
        _, color = remaining.pop(i)
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for c in range(1, width - 1):
                if grid[r][c] == 0:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
